plugins.list.title: List plugins
plugins.list.description: Page through the installed plugins with their version, isolation and whether they are enabled.
plugins.get.title: Get a plugin
plugins.get.description: Get a plugin with the contributions of its current version, the grants it requests and those approved, and all of its versions.
plugins.inspect.title: Inspect a plugin package
plugins.inspect.description: Check an uploaded plugin package without installing it: both manifests, the files and the naming rules; returns its contributions and the grants it requests.
plugins.install.title: Install a plugin
plugins.install.description: Install an uploaded plugin package with the approved grants, which must cover every required grant; the plugin starts disabled.
plugins.grant.title: Grant a plugin
plugins.grant.description: Replace the grants approved for an installed plugin; they must cover every required grant and may add only the optional ones. Send back the concurrency stamp you read.
plugins.delete.title: Uninstall plugins
plugins.delete.description: Uninstall plugins in a batch together with their versions and grants; the same plugin can be installed again afterwards.
openapi.groups.plugins.name: Plugins
openapi.groups.plugins.description: Inspect, install, grant and uninstall third-party plugins on the platform.
openapi.tags.plugins.name: Plugins
openapi.tags.plugins.description: Installed plugins, their versions and the grants approved for them.
permissions.plugins.plugins.read.name: Read plugins
permissions.plugins.plugins.read.descrip: View installed plugins, their contributions, approved grants and versions.
permissions.plugins.plugins.install.name: Install plugins
permissions.plugins.plugins.install.desc: Inspect uploaded plugin packages and install them with the approved grants.
permissions.plugins.plugins.grant.name: Grant plugins
permissions.plugins.plugins.grant.descri: Change the grants approved for an installed plugin.
permissions.plugins.plugins.delete.name: Uninstall plugins
permissions.plugins.plugins.delete.descr: Uninstall plugins together with their versions and grants.

plugins.enable.title: Enable plugins
plugins.enable.description: Enable installed plugins; each one is loaded right after the change is committed, and a load failure is recorded on the plugin.
plugins.disable.title: Disable plugins
plugins.disable.description: Disable plugins; each one is unloaded right after the change is committed, and its permission codes and callbacks are withdrawn.
plugins.status.title: Get plugin status
plugins.status.description: Runtime state of a plugin on the node that answers: whether it is loaded, the loaded version, the lifecycle state and the last load error code.
permissions.plugins.plugins.update.name: Enable plugins
permissions.plugins.plugins.update.descr: Enable or disable installed plugins; enabling loads the plugin on every node.
